content:
The test image shows soybean leaves with:
- Multiple circular to irregular reddish-brown/dark purple spots scattered across the leaf
- Yellow-green mottling/chlorosis around spots
- Spots range from small to medium sized
- Dark reddish-purple borders visible on several lesions

Top candidates: Frogeye_leaf_spot (circular spots with dark borders), Bacterial_Blight (angular lesions), Cercospora. The circular spots with reddish-purple edges point strongly toward Frogeye leaf spot.

The Frogeye reference shows circular spots with gray-tan centers and reddish-purple borders — the same characteristic border pattern visible in the test image. The test image spots are somewhat larger/more advanced, but the reddish-purple bordered circular lesions on soybean leaves match Frogeye leaf spot well. The yellow mottling in the test image is consistent with more progressed infection.
